purpose: Requirements for the agent-review backend: a dependency-free, read-only, per-round reviewer custom Agent that satisfies the review backend contract (availability check, retains_context=false).
summary: Background: default review must work without external tools, message DB or resident sessions
Scope: availability check, read-only reviewer Agent, retains_context declaration; excludes launching, fixing, history, fallback
FNC-1601: reviewer is read-only and may not modify files, git state, or external services
FNC-1602: a fresh reviewer Agent per round with no implicit context inheritance
FNC-1604: side-effect-free availability check of agent definition, read-only constraints, and scripts/docs
FNC-1606: no review history persistence and no resuming under the same review_id
NFR: non-persistence, no external dependencies, fail closed when unverifiable
Acceptance criteria covering distinct agents per round, tool constraints, checks, and no leftover resources
tasks: Implementing the agent-review backend and reviewer Agent
Reviewing or designing the review backend contract
Writing the availability check for the reviewer Agent
Restricting reviewer Agent tools and role instructions
